newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate falls to 5.74 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate falls to 5.74 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills was down at 5.74 percent from 5.75 percent last week, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price rose to 98.570 from 98.567 and the minimum price accepted was 98.554, down from 98.560 a week ago.
Banks submitted bids for 28.70 million dinars worth of bills, up from 27.65 million dinars last week.
The bills, maturing on September 3, were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
